title: Compare the Local Runner with Tekton
description: Progress from an intuitive model to the source implementation and its operational boundary: Compare the Local Runner with Tekton.
learning_objectives: Explain compare the local runner with tekton using a plain-language model
Trace the source implementation for compare the local runner with tekton
Assess failure and operational limits of compare the local runner with tekton
concepts_covered: Tekton executes Task steps as Pods through Kubernetes; this Go engine executes locally and is not a Tekton-compatible controller.
No Kubernetes client, CRDs, or cluster resources are in source; Runner.Execute delegates to the local command executor.
practical_outcomes: Explain at least one operational boundary
completion_criteria: Complete all three lessons and exercise
Score at least 7/10 on the assessment
